description_html: Greg answers questions about how God’s voice can be unmistakable in light of John 10 and 1 Samuel 3, whether the impulse to witness to someone is coming from the conscience or the Holy Spirit, and why worship is required.

title: How Can God’s Voice Be Unmistakable in Light of These Passages?
